repoPath.description: Path to the git repository the worktree is added under.

name.description: Group name; the worktree is created at .cc-worktrees/<name> on branch group/<name>.

preserveExisting.description: If true and a valid git worktree already exists at that path, reuse it instead of recreating it.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the created (or reused) worktree.

branch.description: Group branch checked out in the worktree.

initialCommit.description: HEAD commit SHA of the worktree.

resumed.description: True if an existing worktree at that path was reused instead of being recreated.
